evidence.note: Index strategy epmc-index-v3. Every dataset is measured with the same single section field per tier, so the counts are comparable; the per-tier value is the largest across the dataset's own accessions, excluding any accession shared with other datasets in the corpus. 27 of 29 sampled open-access articles contain the literal accession TARGET-OS; the rest match only because Europe PMC indexes the hyphen as a word break. Counts for this dataset are scaled by 93% accordingly.
Availability dated from the literature (epmc-first-reference-v2) rather than from repository file timestamps, which record re-harmonization. This is a lower bound on availability.
